A Chorus Line two-act production with songs, I Hope I Get It, Sing, and its most famous musical song, One, runs approximately 2:25 and includes one intermission — and is a thrillingly entertaining, witty, and heartbreaking musical that gives dancers a voice!

cn.t: Critics hail this production as a thrilling, polished revival that honors the iconic musical's legacy. The ensemble dazzles with precision dancing and emotional depth, reminding audiences why this backstage classic remains musical theater essential.
